Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.integrated

Class RawlinsSchellhardtFit

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.integrated.RawlinsSchellhardtFit
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RawlinsSchellhardtFit extends Object implements Serializable
Rawlins-Schellhardt gas-well deliverability q = C (pr^2 - pwh^2)^n fitted from field rows.

The relation lumps inflow and tubing between reservoir and wellhead, which is what a wellhead-pressure history contains. Fit it only on rows where the well is on stream with the choke wide open, otherwise the rate reflects the choke setting rather than deliverability. Check the fit on a later hold-out period before trusting a forecast; an exponent n between 0.5 and 1.0 is physical.

1.0
